summary: Frontend-only Records Reactor regression completed on public URL. Core route behavior, 12-record mapping, dial/odometer interactions, keyboard wrap, wheel chapter transitions, reduced-motion behavior, and theme persistence passed. One responsive layout defect remains at 1024x768.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1024x768, dial and specification plate overlap in Records chapter, violating no-overlap responsive requirement.

action_items: Adjust Records Reactor mid-size responsive breakpoints (especially around 1024x768) to guarantee non-overlapping dial and specification regions.
Re-test 1024x768 after layout adjustment while preserving 1920/1366/768/390/320 passes.
critical_code_review_comments: Records route stability is good on direct hash and runtime navigation in repeated checks; earlier selector timeout was a test-flow artifact after chapter transition, not a reproducible route regression.

Records reactor interaction model is correctly isolated from gallery-like palette/category systems: 12 fixed industrial nodes, stable selected-state sync across dial/plaque/rail, and no internal wheel trap.
Touch scrolling contract is implemented via touch-action: pan-y on the dial, supporting native vertical page movement while allowing pointer-based dial interaction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/test_reports/artifacts_iteration_44_matrix for breakpoint evidence. All requested Records checks passed except 1024x768 non-overlap. Re-run matrix after breakpoint tuning; prioritize 1024x768 collision fix without regressing mobile 390x844 and 320x700 long-value rendering.
rca of the issue: RCA: Layout collision at medium desktop/tablet landscape dimensions likely comes from absolute-positioned dial/spec plate geometry crossing before the <=850px mobile rules activate. Reproduction: open #route-records at 1024x768, settle to Records, select long/mixed values (e.g., 20/30/40), observe intersection between reactor-dial and reactor-record-specification bounds. Mitigation: introduce an intermediate breakpoint (around 1100-1200px width and/or <=800px height) to shift/scale dial and specification independently and enforce explicit non-overlap constraints.
